summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 6, 2026, submitting its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange regarding share capital movements for July 2026. The filing shows no changes in authorized or issued shares during the period: Class A ordinary shares remained at 353,324,845 issued and Class B at 81,088,770, with no treasury shares. This is a routine regulatory disclosure requirement for foreign private issuers with a Hong Kong listing, not a special-situation event. There are no transactions, offers, or strategic developments. The filing simply confirms compliance with public float requirements.
